 DGRO: Why The Dividend ETF That Beat SCHD Could Keep Winning
 Nov 17, 2026, 1:49 PM ET iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF (DGRO) SCHD , VYM , VIG , SPY , SP500 3 Comments 2 Likes TQP Research 597 Followers Follow Summary
 I initiate a Buy on the iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF, pairing sustainable dividend growth with long-term capital appreciation.
 DGRO delivered a 13.16% annualized ten-year return, leading three dividend ETF peers, while maintaining substantially less technology exposure than VIG.
 Financials represent 19.4% of DGRO; resilient consumer spending and stronger bank earnings support the dividend-growth thesis.
 DGRO's 25.2x portfolio P/E and lower immediate yield temper enthusiasm; the valuation premium limits the rating to Buy rather than Strong Buy.
